name: ptl-knowledge
description: Search PTL services, case studies, architecture expertise and published knowledge, and map business problems to relevant service evidence.

interface.longDescription: Search PTL services, case studies, architecture expertise and published knowledge. Map business problems to relevant service evidence and discovery questions without producing binding scope, pricing or commercial commitments.
defaultPrompt: Find the most relevant PTL service for this architecture problem.
Show PTL evidence about AI governance.
Build a reading list about cloud transformation.

positive.prompt: Find PTL services related to enterprise architecture and cloud transformation.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching published evidence with canonical source links.

positive.prompt: Find PTL's AI governance service evidence and open the most relevant result.
positive.expected_behavior: Search the public corpus and retrieve the selected result by stable ID.

positive.description: Match a problem to a service
positive.prompt: Our organisation lacks architecture governance across multiple cloud platforms. Which PTL service evidence is relevant?
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant service and case-study evidence, discovery questions and a contact route.

positive.prompt: Build a reading list about AI governance, cybersecurity and cloud architecture.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant published evidence with excerpts and canonical links.

positive.prompt: Map enterprise architecture, technical leadership and vendor governance requirements to published professional evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Map each requirement to evidence without generating a synthetic score.

negative.description: Request for a binding commercial quote
negative.prompt: Give me a binding fixed-price commercial offer for a six-month programme.
Recommend a good restaurant near Budapest city centre.
Edit the PTL website and publish a new service description.

review.commerce_description: This plugin provides free read-only access to published knowledge and does not process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with PTL service search and evidence-based problem matching.
